title: Sign in
deleted: Your account will be deleted. You've been signed out, and we've emailed you the date.
googleFailed: Google sign-in didn't work for this account. Ask your school admin to add you.
confirmEmail: Confirm your email first — we've sent you a new link.
tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
wrong: That email and password don't match. Check them and try again.
